questions.stem: For this calculation only, use the effective torque-transfer model Tₒᵤₜ=η G Tₘ even at stall, with η=0.85, motor-to-load reduction G=20 and motor stall torque Tₘ=0.25 N·m. The motor’s 3000 rpm no-load speed is not its stall speed. What output torque does this model predict?
questions.subtopic: Geared stall torque as a stipulated model
assumptions: η is stipulated as an effective torque-transfer factor for this calculation; do not infer a physical power-efficiency ratio at zero speed or a safe operating envelope.
